headline: Ravi Agarwal files SEBI Takeover Regulation Disclosure under Reg 31(4)
sum: Ravi Agarwal has filed a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI (Substantial Acquisition of Shares and Takeovers) Regulations, 2011, indicating a material acquisition event or change in shareholding in Lloyds Enterprises Limited triggering mandatory exchange notification.
detail: Ravi Agarwal has submitted to NSE a disclosure under Regulation 31(4) of the SEBI Takeover Regulations 2011, the mechanism through which substantial share acquisitions (typically crossing 5% of voting capital) or changes in control are reported to the stock exchange. The filing triggers public disclosure of the acquirer's identity, the number/percentage of shares acquired, the acquisition price/value, and any concert-party arrangements. Regulation 31(4) is a procedural gateway: if the acquisition crosses 25% of voting capital or control shifts, an open offer to public shareholders becomes mandatory under the code.
